LanguageData.Gun_M16A4_RWP.description: The M16A4 is a standard-issue military assault rifle known for its accuracy and burst-fire capability. It offers a good balance of rate of fire and range, making it effective at medium distances. Durable and easy to handle, the M16A4 is well-suited for combat in varied terrains.
